# dify_workflow_tool (Resource)

Manages a workflow tool — a workflow app published as a tool provider. The workflow app must be published for the tool to work; set `publish = true` on the backing `dify_app`. Import by id: `terraform import dify_workflow_tool.x <id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The workflow app must be published before it can become a tool.
resource "dify_app" "research" {
  dsl_yaml = file("${path.module}/research.yaml")
  publish  = true
}

# Publish the workflow app as a workspace tool callable by agents.
resource "dify_workflow_tool" "web_research" {
  workflow_app_id = dify_app.research.id
  name            = "web_research"
  label           = "Web Research"
  description     = "Research a question on the web"
  icon = {
    content    = "🔎"
    background = "#FFEAD5"
  }

  parameters = [
    { name = "query", description = "The question to research", form = "llm" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Tool description shown to agents picking tools.
- `icon` (Attributes) Emoji tile the workspace shows for the tool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--icon))
- `label` (String) Human-readable tool label.
- `name` (String) Tool name (alphanumeric; also the identifier callers see).
- `workflow_app_id` (String) The workflow app this tool publishes. The app must have a published workflow — set `publish = true` on its `dify_app` resource.

### Optional

- `labels` (List of String) Tool labels.
- `parameters` (Attributes List) Parameters the tool accepts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))
- `privacy_policy` (String) Privacy policy URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Workflow tool ID (assigned by Dify).
- `synced` (Boolean) False once the app's published workflow moved past this tool's version.

<a id="nestedatt--icon"></a>
### Nested Schema for `icon`

Required:

- `background` (String) Tile background color.
- `content` (String) Emoji content.


<a id="nestedatt--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Required:

- `description` (String) Parameter description.
- `name` (String) Parameter name.

Optional:

- `form` (String) Parameter form (`llm` fills it from the model, `form` from node config).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Workflow tools are imported by tool ID.
terraform import dify_workflow_tool.example <tool_id>
```
